As a scientist, I believe it is part of my mission to transmit scientific knowledge
to the general public, especially because science has an important role to play in
defining the strategies to tackle the major societal challenges of the XXIst century.

I am happy to talk at conferences, organize workshops for school students, or write
articles for scientific outreach websites.

### Researchers' Night

The "[Researchers' Night](http://www.nuitdeschercheurs.be/2010/index_fr.htm)" is a
yearly event where people can discover what researchers do.

![Researchers' Night 2010](assets/img/researchers-night-2010.png){fig-alt="Researchers' Night 2010"}

I presented our latest research to school students during the
[Water and climate film festival @ UCLouvain](http://www.eauetclimat.be/) and to the
general public during the
[2020 European Researchers' Night](https://ec.europa.eu/research/mariecurieactions/events/european-researchers-night-2020_en) —
[watch the full session on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WX-XkoAwxzM)
(in French).

### Habitat choice in *Tetrahymena* ciliates

This line of research, published in
[Nature Ecology and Evolution](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41559-017-0269-5) and
[PNAS](https://www.pnas.org/content/115/47/11988), is presented for a general
audience on *Science Today*, the UCLouvain outreach website:

- [S'adapter ou changer d'habitat ?](https://uclouvain.be/fr/sciencetoday/actualites/s-adapter-ou-changer-d-habitat.html)
- [Disperser pour survivre](https://uclouvain.be/en/sciencetoday/news/disperser-pour-survivre.html)
